title: The Impact of the 2024 Election on Sleep, Psychological Well-being and Political Cognitive-emotional Burden Among First-time Young Adult Voters.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: To examine the sleep, psychological well-being, and political cognitive-emotional burden of the 2024 United States presidential election on first-time young adult voters.
METHODS: First-time young adult voters (N=186, mean age 20.57 y, SD=0.85) completed an 11-day daily diary and actigraphy protocol spanning the days before, of, and after the November 2024 U.S. presidential election. Daily measures included sleep efficiency (actigraphy), positive and negative affect, distress, rumination, and political concealment. The majority of participants voted for Harris (n=153); a smaller subset reported voting for other candidates.
RESULTS: Across the full sample, sleep efficiency and positive affect declined and distress, negative affect, rumination, and political concealment increased in the days leading up to the election. Negative health effects intensified on the day after the election, with non-Harris voters reporting better health than Harris voters during this period. Most health indicators returned to pre-election levels by the end of the study; positive mood, however, remained lower and negative mood remained higher than pre-election baselines.
CONCLUSIONS: The 2024 national election was associated with measurable, time-limited declines in sleep and mental health among first-time young adult voters, with election-day and post-election effects patterning by candidate preference. Most indicators recovered within days, but mood disturbances persisted beyond the study window, suggesting that elections function as acute political-cognitive stressors with lingering affective consequences for newly enfranchised young adults.

标题：2024年大选对首次投票青年选民睡眠、心理健康及政治认知-情绪负担的影响
摘要：目的：考察2024年美国总统大选对首次投票青年选民睡眠、心理健康及政治认知-情绪负担的影响。
方法：186名首次投票青年选民（平均年龄20.57岁，标准差0.85）在2024年11月美国总统大选前后及当天的11天内完成每日日记和体动记录仪方案。每日测量包括睡眠效率（体动记录仪）、积极和消极情绪、痛苦、反刍思维及政治隐瞒。多数参与者投票给哈里斯（n=153）；少数报告投给其他候选人。
结果：全样本中，大选前夕睡眠效率和积极情绪下降，痛苦、消极情绪、反刍思维和政治隐瞒增加。大选后一天负面健康效应加剧，非哈里斯选民在此期间健康状况优于哈里斯选民。研究结束时多数健康指标恢复到选前水平，但积极情绪仍低于选前基线，消极情绪仍高于选前基线。
结论：2024年全国大选与首次投票青年选民可测量的、暂时性的睡眠和心理健康下降相关，选举日及选后效应因候选人偏好而异。多数指标在数天内恢复，但情绪困扰在研究窗口期后持续存在，表明选举对新获得投票权的青年构成急性政治认知应激源，并产生持久的情感后果。
关键词：情绪负担；睡眠；政治认知；青年选民；选举应激

title: Biopsychosocial Determinants of Frailty in Older People Living With HIV in China: A Bayesian Network Analysis.
summary: People living with HIV (PWH) experience accelerated aging and elevated frailty risk, representing the convergence of biological and psychosocial aging processes. We enrolled 665 PWH ages ≥50 years in a multicenter study in China. We examined the intersection of biological factors (e.g., CD4+ T-cell count, comorbidities), psychological factors (i.e., depression, anxiety), and social determinants in frailty development. A Bayesian network model was developed to characterize these complex interactions. Frailty prevalence was 17.1%. The Bayesian network identified depression as a central node connecting immune dysfunction to frailty through a CD4→anxiety→depression pathway. The model achieved robust performance (area under the curve = 0.879). Probability of frailty ranged from 1.4% in individuals aged 50-59 years without risk factors to 74.0% in those ages ≥70 years with depression and multiple comorbidities. This model offers clinicians a practical risk assessment tool for aging PWH and highlights depression as a modifiable target, supporting the integration of mental health screening in HIV geriatric care.

标题：中国老年HIV感染者衰弱的多生物心理社会决定因素：一项贝叶斯网络分析
摘要：HIV感染者经历加速衰老和衰弱风险升高，这代表了生物和心理社会衰老过程的汇聚。我们在中国的一项多中心研究中招募了665名年龄≥50岁的HIV感染者。我们考察了生物学因素（如CD4+ T细胞计数、合并症）、心理因素（即抑郁、焦虑）和社会决定因素在衰弱发展中的交叉作用。开发了一个贝叶斯网络模型来表征这些复杂交互作用。衰弱患病率为17.1%。贝叶斯网络识别出抑郁是一个中心节点，通过CD4→焦虑→抑郁路径连接免疫功能障碍与衰弱。该模型表现出稳健性能（曲线下面积=0.879）。衰弱概率范围从无风险因素且年龄50-59岁个体的1.4%到伴有抑郁和多种合并症且年龄≥70岁个体的74.0%。该模型为临床医生提供针对老年HIV感染者的实用风险评估工具，并强调抑郁是一个可改变的靶点，支持将心理健康筛查整合到HIV老年护理中。
关键词：情绪；抑郁；焦虑；衰弱；贝叶斯网络

title: Ventrolateral prefrontal-amygdala repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) modulation of impulsivity in borderline personality disorder: a proof-of-concept study.
summary: Impulsivity and emotional dysregulation are core symptoms of Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) for which therapeutic options are very limited. Prior neuroimaging studies suggest that BPD symptoms may be related to fronto-amygdala circuit dysfunction. This proof-of-concept study examined whether individualized ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (VLPFC)-amygdala circuit modulation with Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) could alter impulsivity and emotional dysregulation in BPD. Eleven participants with BPD underwent resting-state functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (rsfMRI) scans to identify individualized right and left VLPFC targets with the strongest functional connectivity to the ipsilateral amygdala. They then performed delayed discounting and emotional reactivity to social exclusion tasks to assess impulsivity and emotional reactivity, respectively, followed by a single session of intermittent Theta Burst Stimulation (iTBS) administered to left and/or right VLPFC targets. Tasks were repeated after stimulation to assess change in impulsivity and reactivity. Mixed-model linear regression analysis showed that right VLPFC, but not the left or bilateral VLPFC stimulation, was associated with a significant reduction of impulsivity (χ2(2) = 7.76, p = 0.02) but not emotional reactivity. No subjects experienced significant adverse events. These results suggest that the right VLPFC iTBS is a safe, tolerable, and promising procedure for modulating impulsivity in BPD.

标题：前额叶腹外侧-杏仁核重复经颅磁刺激(rTMS)对边缘型人格障碍冲动性的调控：一项概念验证研究
摘要：冲动性与情绪失调是边缘型人格障碍(BPD)的核心症状，但目前治疗选择非常有限。先前的神经影像学研究提示，BPD症状可能与额叶-杏仁核环路功能障碍有关。本概念验证研究探讨了个体化的前额叶腹外侧皮层(VLPFC)-杏仁核环路重复经颅磁刺激(rTMS)调控能否改变BPD的冲动性和情绪失调。11名BPD患者接受了静息态功能磁共振成像(rsfMRI)扫描，以识别与同侧杏仁核功能连接最强的个体化左右侧VLPFC靶点。随后，他们分别完成了延迟折扣任务和社会排斥任务中的情绪反应性评估，以测量冲动性和情绪反应性；之后对左侧和/或右侧VLPFC靶点进行一次间歇性θ爆发刺激(iTBS)。刺激后重复上述任务以评估冲动性和反应性的变化。混合模型线性回归分析显示，右侧VLPFC刺激（而非左侧或双侧VLPFC刺激）与冲动性显著降低相关(χ²(2)=7.76, p=0.02)，但对情绪反应性无显著影响。无参与者出现严重不良事件。这些结果表明，右侧VLPFC iTBS是一种安全、耐受性良好且有望调控BPD冲动性的疗法。
关键词：边缘型人格障碍；冲动性；前额叶腹外侧皮层；杏仁核；重复经颅磁刺激
